An instance method, where nothing can read its receiver after the call: no live local of any frame (an exception's handler counted), no other stack place, no static field, no other object; the receiver's fields are among the inputs. An array result, where the code returns an array it made of a length it computes from constants and static tables' lengths that is a constant at the call (crypt_raw's new byte[cdata.length * 4]). An array whose cells hold any values, as an input named by its content. What a call may write is what it reaches through an argument, the receiver, or a static its code takes other than to copy it at once, so bcrypt's tables, which it only clones, stay inputs.
